# adds_administrative_templates (Resource)

Recursively manages Administrative Template files in the Central Store root, `SYSVOL/<domain>/Policies/PolicyDefinitions`. It overwrites only declared files and removes only paths previously recorded in this resource's state. Empty directories are pruned after file deletion; directories containing unrelated files are preserved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every file under source_path is deployed recursively to the Central Store root:
# SYSVOL/<domain>/Policies/PolicyDefinitions.
resource "adds_administrative_templates" "central_store" {
  source_path = "${path.module}/policy_definitions"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_path` (String) Local directory on the machine running Terraform. Every regular file below it is uploaded recursively.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) Fingerprint of source files, recomputed during planning to detect local additions, removals and content changes.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for the managed SYSVOL tree.
- `managed_paths` (Set of String) Relative paths currently owned by this resource. Files outside this set are never removed.
